Methodology.title: How I work
Methodology.subtitle: Methodology
Methodology.p1: My practice is a warm and respectful space tailored for childhood. Here, a secure bond, autonomy, and unstructured free play become the main catalysts for change and learning.
Methodology.p2: Through my own therapeutic model, I integrate the scientific efficacy of cognitive-behavioral psychology with the deep humanistic philosophy of Montessori pedagogy. The result is comprehensive support that respects each child's developmental pace and empowers families.

About.title: About Me
About.subtitle: Professional Profile
About.p1: I am Elisabet García, a general health psychologist specializing in children and adolescents. With over 15 years of professional trajectory, I began my path in Early Intervention, where I acquired deep knowledge about neurodevelopment and prevention for almost a decade.
About.p2: For over five years, I have combined my clinical practice with the role of educational counselor at a prestigious Montessori school. This dual experience, combined with my training in childhood trauma (EMDR) and positive discipline, has allowed me to develop a unique psychotherapeutic model.
About.p3: I firmly believe that every child has their own rhythm and that true change begins when their adult environment decides to look at their inner world with curiosity, respect, and empathy.

therapy.title: Individual Child Therapy
therapy.subtitle: A safe space for emotional growth
therapy.content:
Childhood is full of discoveries, but also complex emotions that children often do not know how to manage. My goal is to provide a safe environment where each child can express what they feel through their natural language: play.

We integrate the cognitive-behavioral model with the Montessori philosophy, promoting autonomy and personal discovery. We work from an absolute respect for the child's developmental stage, offering tools for the prevention and management of difficulties such as anxiety, behavioral problems, irrational fears, and low self-esteem.

assessments.title: Psycho-pedagogical Assessments
assessments.subtitle: Comprehensive evaluations to guide their learning path
assessments.content:
Understanding how a child learns and processes information is the first step to being able to offer the support they need. Psycho-pedagogical assessments allow us to detect Specific Learning Difficulties (SLD), Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), dyslexia, or the presence of High Abilities.

The process is carried out meticulously through the administration of standardized tests, structured clinical observation, and detailed interviews with families and the teaching team. The resulting report is a map that guides curricular adaptations and the focus of necessary future interventions.
benefits: Administration of standardized tests for intelligence, attention, and learning
Contact and coordination with the educational center
Delivery of a detailed report with concrete guidelines

group.title: Group Therapy
group.subtitle: Growing together through mutual respect
group.content:
Group dynamics offer an unbeatable environment for minors to rehearse and consolidate their social skills in real time. We form small groups of similar ages to work on fundamental aspects such as empathy, group self-regulation, assertiveness, and peaceful conflict resolution.

All sessions are framed under the principles of Nonviolent Communication (NVC), promoting active listening and sincere emotional expression, ensuring that each member of the group feels seen, validated, and integrated.
group.benefitsTitle: Aspects we work on in group:
benefits: Training in assertiveness and healthy boundaries
Identification and validation of emotions in others

workshops.title: Workshops for Families and Educators
workshops.subtitle: Equipping the child's environment with tools
workshops.content:
A child's well-being is deeply intertwined with that of their family and caregivers. These practical workshops are designed for parents and educational professionals who wish to incorporate a more respectful, conscious, and connected approach in their daily lives.

We respond to the daily challenges of parenting and education (managing tantrums, use of devices, routines, and rules) relying on the pillars of Positive Discipline and the Montessori model. We firmly believe that to raise confident children we need adults with solid tools.
benefits: Prevention of digital risks in childhood

parents.title: Parental Guidance
parents.subtitle: Support for conscious and secure parenting
parents.content:
Parenting is full of daily challenges that often generate doubts, guilt, or stress in family dynamics. This exclusive service for parents offers a safe space to analyze what is happening at home and find the origin of the conflicts, without judgment and with the utmost empathy.

We will work together to understand what your child needs to communicate with their behavior, and we will build practical strategies based on Positive Discipline and the Montessori methodology to foster cooperation, establish respectful boundaries, and repair or strengthen the affective bond. Regaining calm and confidence in your role as parents is possible.
benefits: Establishing rules and routines without yelling
Management of parental stress and self-care
Conflict resolution and fostering cooperation at home
